accountSwitch.warning: This browser remembers accounts you have signed in to. Passwords are not saved. Switching shows only that account's icons, files, and settings. Visitors do not get this list. Forgetting an account removes it from this browser and does not delete it on the server. On a shared computer, sign out and forget accounts before you leave.

backup.started: The backup download has started. Keep the file where only you can access it.
backup.warning: This download is for your own storage. The archive contains a SQLite database snapshot, uploaded images, configuration, and custom files. It can include password hashes, keys, and private navigation data. Do not send it to anyone or put it in a public directory. Downloading does not overwrite data or stop the program. If the program uses MySQL, this page cannot export or restore the database; back up MySQL yourself.
backup.restoreTitle: Restore from a backup made by this program
backup.restoreRisk: Restore overwrites the current database, uploaded images, conf/conf.ini, and web/custom. Changes made after the backup are lost, and accounts and passwords return to that point. This cannot be undone. Only a compatible SQLite backup exported by this program is accepted. Incompatible or newer-version archives are rejected. Paths must stay inside the application directory. MySQL cannot be restored here. The program keeps running; port and other configuration changes apply on the next start.
backup.restoreConfirmBody: Replace the current data with the selected backup? The current data is not kept automatically. Use a backup exported by this program, and keep a separate copy of anything you still need.
backup.acknowledge: I understand this overwrites the current data
backup.restored: The backup has replaced the current data. The page will reload.
